selected.assay: bulk RNA-seq (Illumina NextSeq 500), mouse brain; 4 regions (cerebellum, cortex, SN, striatum)
selected.sample_inclusion: n=4 animals per group for RNA-seq; all 4 regions dissected from each animal (S2.5.p1); a separate cohort of 5/group was used for histology only
selected.primary_estimand: Effect of 12-week treadmill exercise in MPTP-induced PD mice: MPTP+EX vs MPTP, within each brain region (S3.2.p1, S3.3.p1, FIG3)
planned_contrasts: MPTP+EX vs MPTP per region (exercise effect in PD; S3.2.p1, FIG2B/D)
MPTP vs Saline per region (PD model effect; S3.2.p1, FIG2A/D)
Reversal sets in SN and striatum: genes significant in both contrasts with opposite direction (S3.3.p1, FIG3A/D): SN 155 down / 66 up after exercise; striatum 49 down / 185 up
selected.repeated_measure_unit: animal (4 regions per animal); regions analyzed separately so each animal appears once per fit
selected.paper_method: DESeq (v1.14.0), per region; DEG if FPKM > 1 and p < 0.05 (S2.7.p1)

decisions.reason: S2.5.p1 gives n=4 per group for RNA-seq across 4 regions; S2.7.p1 gives the method (DESeq) and DEG rule (FPKM>1, p<0.05, raw p, no fold-change cutoff). S3.2.p1 and FIG2 compare MPTP vs saline and MPTP+EX vs MPTP per region. S3.3.p1/FIG3 report counts only for reversal sets (opposite direction in the two contrasts), not per-contrast DEG totals; per-contrast totals are only in FIG2D Venn diagrams, not in the text.

checks: GEO series: 48 samples = 3 treatments x 4 regions x 4 reps, matching S2.5.p1
matrix GSE205907_fpkm has 48 columns encoding the same 3 groups x 4 regions x 4 animals
tissue markers match region labels (Pcp2/Gabra6 cerebellum, Satb2/Neurod6 cortex, Th/Slc6a3 SN, Ppp1r1b/Penk striatum)
Th/Slc6a3 in SN ~4-7x lower in E and M animals than S animals, consistent with MPTP lesion (S3.5.p1: ~70% TH+ loss)
Xist expressed and no Y-linked genes in every sample: all female as in S2.1.p1

decisions.reason: Only supplementary file of the series; the paper's data availability statement names GSE205907. Marker genes corroborate region and lesion labels.

The deposited matrix columns (E26Nigra, M6Stria, S1Cortex, ...) carry animal ID, group and region, while GEO titles carry only '<region>,<treatment>,rep<k>'; no field links animal IDs to rep numbers or GSM IDs except column order, and positional alignment is not allowed. The metadata is therefore a sample sheet derived deterministically from the matrix column names by prep_GSE205907.py (prefix E=MPTP+exercise, M=MPTP, S=Saline; suffix = region), exact-matched on the index. The derived group x region table equals the GEO treatment x tissue table (4 per cell), S=Saline is corroborated by preserved nigral Th/Slc6a3, and E/M are the two MPTP-lesioned groups; E vs M decoding rests on the letters (Exercise, MPTP). GSM IDs are not attached to samples (not needed for the estimand).

Values are non-integer (only zeros are integral; 2.4e-6 of non-zero values are integers), column sums 345k-621k (not library sizes, typical of FPKM), the file name says fpkm and the paper says FPKM. GEO data_processing mentions HTSeq counts, but the deposited values are not counts. Linear normalized scale -> log2(x+1) and limma. 27 gene IDs mangled by Excel into dates were dropped (prep script).

Three-level group factor (Saline, MPTP, MPTP+EX), analyzed separately in each region as in the paper (S3.2.p1). One limma model per region with planned contrasts, no pooled levels. Exercise estimand = MPTP+EX vs MPTP (the paper has no healthy exercised arm, so this is exercise within PD only). MPTP vs Saline is needed for the paper's reversal sets. EX vs SAL is exploratory. Regions are strata; comparisons never cross them.

Within a region each animal contributes one sample, so animals are independent units; no batch, sex (all female) or other covariate is recorded. The 4-regions-per-animal structure is not relevant to per-region fits.

paper_route.reason: only FPKM was deposited; DESeq needs raw counts (GEO data_processing mentions HTSeq counts but they are not deposited)

deviations: limma on log2(FPKM+1) instead of DESeq on counts
FPKM>1 filter interpreted as FPKM>=1 in >=4 of the 12 region samples

decisions.reason: Matrix-method policy: linear FPKM -> log2(x+1) -> limma. Paper's DESeq route cannot run on FPKM; declared deviation.

selected.deviation_note: paper rule (raw p < 0.05, no fold-change cutoff, FPKM > 1 expression filter) applied to limma p-values; BH FDR < 0.05 reported as audit

decisions.reason: S2.7.p1: 'DEGs which FPKM > 1 and p < 0.05'; FIG3 legend repeats FPKM > 1, P < 0.05. Raw p, no fold-change rule.

caveats: Paper reports reversal-set sizes (SN 155 down/66 up, striatum 49 down/185 up after exercise), not per-contrast DEG totals; these are compared from a post-hoc overlap of our MPTP vs SAL and EX vs MPTP tables (reversal_sets.csv), not by the runner.
Exercise effect is estimated only within MPTP-lesioned mice (no healthy exercise arm).
n=4 per group; raw p<0.05 without multiplicity control yields many expected false positives (~5% of tested genes).
Sample-to-GSM mapping not established non-positionally; group labels decoded from matrix column names.
